name: Dispatch
description: Hand a note to a coding agent: a button in the note's header (and a command, ⌘⇧↩) starts Claude Code in a new terminal on this machine (or another of your machines), told to read the note and do what it asks. Its actions are yours to change: another agent, another prompt, or a shell command of your own. Terminal's `vau terminal run` starts them, which scheduled notes use too.
author: Vaultite
